# Under/over arrow and accent references

The48 primary cases use fresh VMs of the unchanged SHA-pinned MathJax3.2.2 assets embedded in D2 v0.8.1. They cover short/long right/left over/under arrows, fraction/script bases, nested arrows, up/down stacks, ordinary arrows/vector/bar/hat/wide accents and color/bold contexts. Original complete SVG hashes, dimensions and internal operator mathaccent policy are retained.

D050's direct Overset/Underset dispatch upgrades the eight up/down stack cases to raw primary SVG and dimension checks, so forty-four complete SVGs now match exactly. The two ordinary-arrow controls retain immutable complete baseline equality for their preexisting token grouping. Two bar cases allow only the primary's specific transparent ORD TeXAtom wrapper to be absent; the helper validates the exact path, attributes, namespace and single child, removes that exact pair of tags, and then requires every other SVG byte unchanged. It does not normalize transforms or positions. The known baseline single translation and source/candidate split translation have equal exact decimal composed path geometry. Source hashes and all strict initial failures are preserved in review evidence.

All48 marker policies are checked. The ordinary-arrow pair has an explicit unchanged token-grouping boundary: the primary combines adjacent up/down mo tokens; Go retains two unmarked tokens. Both original primary grouping and exact Go grouping are asserted, with no omitted policy check. Direct boundary controls exercise semantic parent/base exclusion, existing false/null markers, multi-character and nonmatching operators. Renderer controls distinguish explicit delimiter alias or selected size character from an ordinary stretch glyph, unselected/zero/multipart size values.

The source follows MmlMo.checkMathAccent and CommonTextNode.remappedText. Existing defined markers and embellished bases remain untouched. Only the primary's finite single-character accent set is marked, and an explicit stretch character bypasses accent remapping. The original D049 marker/remapping correction remains unchanged. The later D050 direct-dispatch change is documented separately in stack_placement_README.md; it removes only the eight superseded SVG qualifications here. No marker policy, global CoreMO change or SVG tolerance is introduced.
